{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l1707_1973_n006",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 the GOOD response to a medical question explains possible causes and suggests precautions rather than giving a definitive diagnosis",
    "C2 the BAD response gives a definitive diagnosis, which the avoid-regulated-advice rule prohibits",
    "C3 the example illustrates the avoid-regulated-advice rule: equip the user with information, do not provide definitive regulated advice, and include a disclaimer"
  ],
  "acts": ["respond_with(R)"],
  "concepts": [
    { "name": "avoid_regulated_advice_rule", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "R is subject to the rule that the assistant should equip users with information without providing definitive regulated advice and include a disclaimer",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "medical_question", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "Q is a user question asking for a diagnosis or medical explanation of symptoms",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example is introduced as a medical question, so the question class must exist",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "definitive_diagnosis", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "R states a single definitive diagnosis as the answer to the user's medical question",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "informative_response", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "R explains possible causes and suggests precautions without giving a definitive diagnosis",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "answers_question", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "response R answers question Q",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example relates each response to the user's question it answers",
      "toggleable": false }
  ],
  "ontology": [],
  "asserts": [
    { "read_back": "responding with % is forbidden because it gives a definitive diagnosis to a medical question",
      "read_back_slots": ["R"],
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1707_1973_n006", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "status": "forbid", "act": "respond_with(R)",
      "body": "definitive_diagnosis(R), medical_question(Q), answers_question(R, Q)" }
  ],
  "beats": [], "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    { "act_class": "respond_with", "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the example forbids only a response that gives a definitive diagnosis; an informative response that explains causes and suggests precautions is the GOOD example, so silence permits it" }
  ],
  "requires": ["avoid_regulated_advice_rule/1"],
  "inputs": ["medical_question/1", "definitive_diagnosis/1", "informative_response/1", "answers_question/2"],
  "forbid_body": []
}
